name: claude
title: Claude Code
installScript:
set -eu
d=$(mktemp -d)
curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh -o "$d/install.sh"
bash "$d/install.sh"
rm -rf "$d"
sudo ln -sf "$HOME/.local/bin/claude" /usr/local/bin/claude
notes: Model calls go to api.anthropic.com through HTTPS_PROXY with the placeholder as the key; the egress proxy puts the anthropic secret in its place. Node trusts the egress CA through NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS.
Telemetry to Datadog (http-intake.logs.us5.datadoghq.com) and release notes from raw.githubusercontent.com are off with CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC, and denied if anything still tries.

customApiKeyResponses in ~/.claude.json approves the placeholder ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (Claude Code keeps the last 20 characters of a key it approved), so an interactive session does not ask about it; claude -p uses it without asking either way.

hasCompletedOnboarding in ~/.claude.json skips the first-run onboarding, whose connection check to platform.claude.com is denied and ends the session; the folder trust question still comes up once per project.

permissions.defaultMode = auto: an unattended claude -p edits files and runs commands that its automatic review allows, instead of stopping at a prompt nobody answers (verified with an API key and Haiku).

subscription.pasteHint: run claude setup-token (on the Mac or anywhere), sign in with the subscription, and paste the token it prints
